$comment: Life Dashboard pilot dashboard (PostHog EU). Create each insight as SQL (HogQL) in PostHog after sign-up; names and KPI IDs follow docs/measurement/KPI-PLAN.md. Days are Asia/Bangkok calendar days; weeks start Monday. A week is measurable only when it is complete and has at least one event (with one owner, zero events cannot be told apart from 'no consent on this device' or 'analytics off'); otherwise the value is NULL = not measurable.

query.query: SELECT event, count() AS events, max(timestamp) AS last_seen FROM events WHERE properties.product = 'life-dashboard' AND timestamp >= now() - INTERVAL 1 DAY GROUP BY event ORDER BY events DESC

insights.name: KPI-O-01 Owner active days per week
insights.min_volume: complete week with >= 1 event, else not measurable

query.query: SELECT toStartOfWeek(toTimeZone(timestamp, 'Asia/Bangkok'), 1) AS week, count() AS events, uniqIf(toDate(toTimeZone(timestamp, 'Asia/Bangkok')), event IN ('habit_logged', 'task_status_changed')) AS active_days, if(events >= 1 AND week < toStartOfWeek(toTimeZone(now(), 'Asia/Bangkok'), 1), active_days, NULL) AS active_days_measured FROM events WHERE properties.product = 'life-dashboard' AND timestamp >= now() - INTERVAL 12 WEEK GROUP BY week ORDER BY week

insights.name: KPI-L-01 Daily review days per week (/tasks opened)
insights.min_volume: complete week with >= 1 event, else not measurable

query.query: SELECT toStartOfWeek(toTimeZone(timestamp, 'Asia/Bangkok'), 1) AS week, count() AS events, uniqIf(toDate(toTimeZone(timestamp, 'Asia/Bangkok')), event = '$pageview' AND properties.$pathname = '/tasks') AS review_days, if(events >= 1 AND week < toStartOfWeek(toTimeZone(now(), 'Asia/Bangkok'), 1), review_days, NULL) AS review_days_measured FROM events WHERE properties.product = 'life-dashboard' AND timestamp >= now() - INTERVAL 12 WEEK GROUP BY week ORDER BY week

insights.name: KPI-L-02 Habit logging days per week
insights.min_volume: complete week with >= 1 event, else not measurable

query.query: SELECT toStartOfWeek(toTimeZone(timestamp, 'Asia/Bangkok'), 1) AS week, count() AS events, uniqIf(toDate(toTimeZone(timestamp, 'Asia/Bangkok')), event = 'habit_logged' AND properties.change = 'done') AS habit_days, if(events >= 1 AND week < toStartOfWeek(toTimeZone(now(), 'Asia/Bangkok'), 1), habit_days, NULL) AS habit_days_measured FROM events WHERE properties.product = 'life-dashboard' AND timestamp >= now() - INTERVAL 12 WEEK GROUP BY week ORDER BY week

insights.name: KPI-L-03 Task status updates per week
insights.min_volume: complete week with >= 1 event, else not measurable

query.query: SELECT toStartOfWeek(toTimeZone(timestamp, 'Asia/Bangkok'), 1) AS week, count() AS events, countIf(event = 'task_status_changed') AS status_updates, countIf(event = 'task_status_changed' AND properties.status = 'done') AS completed, if(events >= 1 AND week < toStartOfWeek(toTimeZone(now(), 'Asia/Bangkok'), 1), status_updates, NULL) AS status_updates_measured FROM events WHERE properties.product = 'life-dashboard' AND timestamp >= now() - INTERVAL 12 WEEK GROUP BY week ORDER BY week

insights.name: KPI-L-04 Module coverage per week
insights.min_volume: complete week with >= 1 event, else not measurable

query.query: SELECT toStartOfWeek(toTimeZone(timestamp, 'Asia/Bangkok'), 1) AS week, count() AS events, uniqIf(arrayElement(splitByChar('/', toString(properties.$pathname)), 2), event = '$pageview' AND arrayElement(splitByChar('/', toString(properties.$pathname)), 2) IN ('tasks', 'goals', 'habits', 'decisions', 'revenue', 'finance', 'knowledge', 'accounts', 'integrations', 'saas')) AS modules_opened, if(events >= 1 AND week < toStartOfWeek(toTimeZone(now(), 'Asia/Bangkok'), 1), modules_opened, NULL) AS modules_opened_measured FROM events WHERE properties.product = 'life-dashboard' AND timestamp >= now() - INTERVAL 12 WEEK GROUP BY week ORDER BY week

insights.name: KPI-G-01 Owner write failure rate
insights.min_volume: 10 writes per week, else not measurable

query.query: SELECT toStartOfWeek(toTimeZone(timestamp, 'Asia/Bangkok'), 1) AS week, countIf(event IN ('habit_logged', 'task_status_changed', 'owner_write_failed')) AS writes, countIf(event = 'owner_write_failed') AS failures, if(writes >= 10, round(100 * failures / writes, 1), NULL) AS failure_rate_pct FROM events WHERE properties.product = 'life-dashboard' AND timestamp >= now() - INTERVAL 12 WEEK GROUP BY week ORDER BY week
